verdict.rationale: The README documents an end-to-end bring-up path. You flash the board with flash.sh, sign the app with a free Apple ID, and plug the board into the phone (USB-C directly, Lightning via adapter). A four-step in-app setup then checks each step itself and auto-calibrates the pointer. Finally you enter a model endpoint, type a goal and press Start. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent report of someone completing a first task from the docs alone, and the app build/sideload steps and the full hardware prerequisites list are thin in the evidence.
